help.title: How to use this app
help.firstRunHint: Walk through ODBC detection, template queries, and template scripts step by step.

connection.retrying: Reconnecting to the local server… testing the connection now.
connection.retried: Reconnected — the local server is answering again. Carry on; no refresh needed.
connection.failed: Retry failed — the local server is still not answering. It may still be starting up; try again in a moment.
connection.offline: Lost connection to the local server. Your work is safe in this tab. It usually comes back on its own within a minute; if not, launch ODBCQueryApp.exe again — the page will reconnect without a refresh.

update.waitingIdle: Waiting for running queries to finish…
update.restarting: Installing the update and restarting — this tab reconnects automatically.
update.available: A new version ({{latest}}) is available — you are on {{current}}.
update.stalledRestarting: Still restarting — this page reconnects on its own. If nothing happens within a minute, close it and start the app again; the update is already installed.
update.stalledLost: Lost contact with the app during the update — it should come back on its own. If it stays quiet, restart the app and run the update again.
update.unsupported: This copy of the app cannot update itself. Close it and open the newest ODBCQueryApp.exe ({{latest}}) to upgrade.
update.updatedToast: Updated to version {{version}} — refreshing to load the new interface…
update.requiredText: This version ({{current}}) is no longer supported. Version {{latest}} is required to continue.
update.requiredAuto: “Update now” downloads the new build, waits for running queries to finish, then restarts the app automatically — this tab reconnects on its own.
update.requiredManual: Automatic update is not available in this environment. Please close the app and copy the latest ODBCQueryApp.exe from your IT team's share folder.

shutdown.title: Shut down server
shutdown.confirm: This stops the embedded ODBCQueryApp server and disconnects any connected users. You can close this tab afterwards. Continue?
shutdown.stopped: The server has been stopped. You can now close this tab.
